repos_data.description: The beautiful game in your terminal. Minimal TUI app to keep up with live & recent football/soccer matches written in Go.

⚽ Live football(soccer) scores, fixtures and standings for the competition you follow (World Cup, Premier League, LALIGA, Champions League and 12 more) in your terminal, your Claude Code and Cursor CLI statusline, and MCP clients. No API key. Independent fan project. Not affiliated with FIFA, any confederation, league or club, or Anthropic.
AI companion for FIFA World Cup 2026 — 18 tools covering matches, teams, venues, city guides, fan zones, visa info, head-to-head records, and more. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Telegram.
MCP server exposing the free SportScore sports-data API as tool calls for Claude, Cursor, and Zed. Live scores, fixtures, standings for football, basketball, cricket, tennis.
MCP server for OpenFoot API — football fixtures, standings, lineups, live events, shot-level xG and match context for AI agents.
